title: Evidence Table
description: DISCOVER-stage exit artifact. Output of lit-scout: the graded set of sources gathered for a query, plus a snowball-saturation flag. Domain-agnostic. The evidence-verifier hard gate reads this to decide PASS/BLOCK; sources are carried by reference, never inlined.

ref.description: [[slug]]+sha, DOI, arXiv id, or URL — a resolvable reference, never inlined content

saturation_reached.description: true when snowball search stopped surfacing new relevant sources
